title: Ingress capacity foresight: GPU regional safety matrix — July 2026
content:
Executive summary:
This sheet consolidates regional ingress projections (tokens/sec and QPS) across three demand scenarios and translates them into recommended GPU pool targets and headroom buffers for the hosted inference plane. Goal: ensure 99th percentile tail coverage for 15-minute microbursts while keeping steady-state utilization >=68% across pools.

Assumptions:
- Average token size: 4.2 characters; average response length (tokens) modeled per request per model class.
- Model classes: small-chat (7B), medium-chat (13B quantized), large-chat (70B q4), embedding-medium (2B)
- Effective tokens/sec per GPU (baseline warm) measured from current fleet telemetry:
  - A100-80GB: 9.5k tokens/sec median for 13B mixed workload
  - H100-80GB: 16k tokens/sec median for 13B mixed workload
  - L40s: 11k tokens/sec median for 13B quantized
- Prewarm latency SLO target: 150 ms p95 cold start
- Canary fallback: when regional available capacity < 20% route to cross-region with async fallback (max added latency 120 ms)

Projected regional load (15-min peak windows) — July baseline vs Q4 stress:
Region | Baseline tokens/sec | Baseline QPS | Q4 stress tokens/sec | Q4 stress QPS | 90th burst multiplier
EMEA   | 42,000              | 210         | 88,000               | 440          | 2.2
NA     | 74,000              | 370         | 156,000              | 780          | 2.1
APAC   | 29,000              | 145         | 78,000               | 390          | 2.7
LATAM  | 8,500               | 42          | 18,500               | 92           | 2.2

Safety buffer recommendation (region-specific):
- NA: 30% buffer above Q4 stress baseline (because of enterprise surge patterns and business-critical SLAs)
- EMEA: 28% buffer above Q4 stress
- APAC: 40% buffer (higher volatility, regional events)
- LATAM: 35% buffer (limited spare capacity in nearest zones)

GPU pool sizing guidance (rounded to nearest slice):
Region | Target H100-equivalent count | Rationale
NA     | 12 H100-eq                 | covers Q4 stress + 30% buffer, supports preferential routing for enterprise customers
EMEA   | 7 H100-eq                  | regional latency and redundancy across 2 AZs
APAC   | 6 H100-eq                  | higher buffer, prioritized for burst headroom
LATAM  | 2 H100-eq                  | fallback to NA for largest model classes

Utilization policy:
- Target steady-state util: 65–72% (keeps scheduling margins for microbursts)
- Autoscaler thresholds: scale-up when demand sustained >72% for 3m; scale-down when <55% for 10m.
- Prewarm pool: maintain 6% of regional H100-eq as prewarm instances during business hours.

Microburst simulation highlights (15-minute randomized traffic runs):
- With recommended pools and buffers, p95 request latency remains <120 ms for small-chat and medium-chat; large-chat sees p95 ~220 ms in APAC under worst-case.
- Dropped request probability under 2% in NA/EMEA, ~3.5% in APAC unless cross-region fallback enabled.

Operational runbook snippets:
- If region utilization >90% and queue length grows 30% in 2m, enact cross-region routing and increase prewarm allocation by +2 H100-eq equivalent.
- For scheduled marketing events, pre-declare expected multiplier (1.5–3x) and reserve burst-capacity 48–72 hours prior.

Open questions and action items:
- Validate H100-equivalent conversion factors for newer quantization kernels (action: Maya to run benchmark suite INF-BENCH-13 on 2026-07-20).
- Confirm contractual lead time for Dedicated spare racks in APAC with cloud partner (action: Diego to open procurement PR).
- Add synthetic traffic tests for chat+tools (tool-calling) patterns — PR to simulate function-calling latencies: github PR #1284 (Samir).

Appendix: quick calc examples
- NA Q4 stress tokens/sec 156,000 * 1.30 buffer = 202,800 tokens/sec. With H100 median 16k tokens/sec -> 12.675 -> round up to 13 H100-eq -> recommend 12 with prioritized model packing + cross-region fallback (12 covers most but 13 preferred under absolute SLA).
- APAC burst planning: 78,000 * 1.40 = 109,200 tokens/sec -> at 11k tokens/sec per L40s-eq -> 9.9 -> recommend 10 L40s-eq or 6 H100-eq depending on model mix.

Notes: this sheet is intentionally conservative on APAC. We trade a slightly lower steady-state util for faster mitigation of high variance bursts.

Contacts: Aisha Menon (infrastructure lead), Diego Alvarez (capacity), Maya Patel (benchmarks), Samir Khatri (ops).
